By the sky with its great stars.
By the Day that was promised.
By the one who sees and what is seen.
The people of the ditch were destroyed.
The ditch with the fire and its wood.
They were sitting beside it.
And they were watching what they did to the believers.
They were angry with the believers only because they believed in Allah, the Strong, the Praised.
The kingdom of the sky and the earth belongs to Him. And Allah sees everything.
People who hurt the believing men and women and did not say sorry will have the punishment of Hell and the burning.
People who believe and do good will have gardens with rivers flowing under them. That is the great win.
The grip of your Lord is very strong.
He is the One who starts creation and then brings it back.
And He is the Forgiving and the Loving.
The Owner of the great Throne.
He does whatever He wants.
Has the story of the armies come to you?
The armies of Pharaoh and Thamud.
But people who said no keep on saying it is a lie.
And Allah is all around them.
In truth, this is a great Quran.
It is on a Preserved Tablet where nothing can be changed.
